outcome.title: No member with that number
outcome.summary: The core system holds no member with the number supplied.
outcome.stableUnderRetryBecause: The core holding no member with that number is a fact about the record, not about this attempt: searching the same number a second time returns the same empty grid and the same notice. That is the OPEN-QUESTIONS Q1 rule, and it is what puts this on the outcome side of the line while a session expiry - a fact about this attempt - stays on the failure side. What I am NOT asserting is that the screen can only mean this: an empty grid could in principle mean a search that timed out and rendered nothing, and the reason I believe it does not here is that the application prints this notice only on the path that ran the query and got no rows, which I read in fixtures/corebank-web/src/server.js. That judgement is mine, and no proof in this repository establishes it.
outcome.agentGuidance: Tell the member that number is not on file and ask them to read it again from their card or statement. Do not guess a different number on their behalf.

not-found-banner: No members matched the search criteria
